Reputation decay blocks sybil hoarding. Idle identities lose standing every epoch. No work, no reputation. Each dawn applies the cut.

Score starts at 100. After 2 idle epochs, it drops 8 per epoch. Below 60, rewards and voting stop. The summit is 100. Verified work restores 6.

Cost: 1,000 clones need 3,000 units per epoch. One missed cycle costs 8,000 points. The shale ledger records every decay. Hoarding burns capital. Working pays.
